title: French Chicken Wings Bowl
description: A twist on traditional Korean-style fried chicken wings, served in a light and zesty French-inspired bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep fryer or a large pot to 375°F (190°C).
In a shallow dish, mix together the cornstarch, flour, and a pinch of salt.
Dredge the chicken wings in the cornstarch mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip the wings in the egg, making sure they're fully coated.
Dredge the wings in the flour mixture again, pressing the coating onto the wings to adhere.
Heat the buttermilk in a separate shallow dish.
Add the coated wings to the buttermilk, making sure they're fully submerged.
Let the wings marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the wings from the buttermilk, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Fry the wings in batches until golden brown and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes per batch.
In a small bowl, mix together the zesty sauce, light soy sauce, and korean chili flakes.
Toss the fried wings in the sauce until fully coated.
Serve the wings in a bowl with your choice of additional ingredients, such as steamed vegetables, pickled ginger, and kimchi.
